title: gregllm
tagline: A Claude Code skill that answers "what will this GregTech: New Horizons build cost?" down to raw materials.
highlights: Expands multiblocks and batch crafts over real GTNH 2.9.0 recipe data (~93 MB) into raw materials, EU/t, duration and total EU
Picks the cheapest recipe chain under your voltage tier, then Claude confirms each choice with you
Downloads the recipe data on first run and verifies it against a pinned hash; no npm dependencies
Plan files pin recipe choices so a cost breakdown can be reproduced
role: Solo: calculator, data pipeline, Claude Code skill
problem: In GregTech: New Horizons a single machine can hide hundreds of crafting steps across many tiers of recipes. Players plan builds in spreadsheets. I wanted to just ask "what will this cost?" and get the full raw-material bill, power use and leftovers.

challenges.title: A recipe graph with real choices
challenges.body: Most items have several recipes and ore-dictionary slots that accept many items. With --auto the calculator picks the cheapest chain under your voltage tier, then Claude confirms those picks with you, and plan files pin them so the answer can be reproduced.

challenges.title: Data the repo isn't allowed to ship
challenges.body: The recipe export has no license and contains game content, so the repo doesn't include it. A setup script downloads a pinned copy and verifies its hash on first run.

challenges.title: Keeping the LLM honest
challenges.body: Claude never does the arithmetic. The skill tells it to run the scripts, ask for your tier, and surface each assumption before giving a final answer.

replay.title: Ask Claude what a build costs
replay.note: Reconstruction. The conversation was written for this page; the terminal output is real, from the calculator on GTNH 2.9.0 recipe data.

steps.you: How much do 4 Electric Blast Furnaces cost? I'm in MV.
steps.claude: I'll run the calculator capped at MV and let it pick the cheapest recipe chain, then check those picks with you.
steps.term:
$ node scripts/calc.mjs --item "Electric Blast Furnace" --amount 4 --auto --tier MV
GTNH 2.9.0  targets: 4x Electric Blast Furnace

Raw materials:
  168x  Cast Iron Ingot
  24x  Charcoal Dust
  72x  Cobblestone (minecraft)
  50x  Copper Ingot (IC2)
  36x  Flint
  24x  Glass Dust
  64x  Invar Ingot
  66x  Liveroot Dust
  288 L  Molten Polyethylene (PE)  (= 2 ingots)
  432 L  Molten Red Alloy  (= 3 ingots)
  1152 L  Molten Rubber  (= 8 ingots)
  864 L  Molten Soldering Alloy  (= 6 ingots)
  12x  Red Alloy Ingot
  24x  Steel Ingot
  48x  Sticky Resin
  4x  Tin Ingot (gregtech)
steps.caption: Everything expands down to ingots, dusts and fluids.

steps.you: What machines am I running, and how much power?
steps.claude: 22 machine steps, all LV or lower, and 210,352 EU in total. You'll end up with 4 spare circuit boards.
steps.term:
Steps (22):
  4x Crafting (Shaped) -> Electric Blast Furnace
  12x Crafting (Shaped) -> Blast Furnace
  84x Crafting (Shaped) -> Cast Iron Plate
  12x Circuit Assembler -> Electronic Circuit  15 EU/t LV, 10s each
  22x Centrifuge -> Wood Pulp (gregtech)  5 EU/t LV, 25.2s each
  8x Bending Machine -> Copper Foil  24 EU/t LV, 6.3s each
  24x Alloy Smelter -> Glass Tube  15 EU/t LV, 6s each
  …

Total energy: 210,352 EU

Leftovers / byproducts:
  4x  Circuit Board
  2x  Wood Pulp (gregtech)
steps.caption: Each machine step with its EU/t and duration.

steps.you: Are those the recipes I'd actually use?
steps.claude: It assumed hand-crafted plates and casings. If you'd rather use a Bending Machine for the plates, I'll pin that in a plan file and rerun.
steps.term:
Auto-picked recipes (pin in plan.choices to keep, or change):
  Electric Blast Furnace: Crafting (Shaped)
  Blast Furnace: Crafting (Shaped)
  Cast Iron Plate: Crafting (Shaped)
  Heat Proof Machine Casing: Crafting (Shaped)
  Invar Plate: Crafting (Shaped)
  Invar Frame Box: Crafting (Shaped)
  Invar Rod: Crafting (Shaped)
  1x Tin Cable: Cable Coating
steps.caption: Assumptions are shown, so Claude can confirm them instead of guessing.
